unit_cn: Unit 1 A New Start 新的开始
source: 外研社(新标准)必修第一册 Unit 1 词表(p105-106 真词);课标必修词优先,跳过专有名词;IPA 英音回填自单元词表;例句原创、围绕'高中新开始/社团/适应'主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: My first day at senior high school was both exciting and scary.
words.example_cn: 我高中的第一天既兴奋又害怕。

words.example_en: I was curious about every corner of my new campus.
words.example_cn: 我对新校园的每个角落都很好奇。

words.example_en: I wanted to make a good first impression on my new classmates.
words.example_cn: 我想给新同学留下好的第一印象。

words.example_en: The campus was still quiet when I arrived early in the morning.
words.example_cn: 我清晨早早到时,校园还很安静。

words.example_en: Welcoming new students with a concert is an old tradition at our school.
words.example_cn: 用音乐会迎接新生是我们学校的老传统。

words.example_en: Our new school has modern sports facilities and a large library.
words.example_cn: 我们的新学校有现代化的体育设施和一座大图书馆。

words.meaning_cn: 令人钦佩的;给人深刻印象的
words.example_en: Lisa gave an impressive talk about her high school years.
words.example_cn: 莉萨做了一场令人印象深刻的高中生活演讲。

words.example_en: I will never forget the moment I introduced myself to the class.
words.example_cn: 我永远不会忘记向全班做自我介绍的那一刻。

words.example_en: The author of the diary describes his first day at senior high.
words.example_cn: 这篇日记的作者描述了他高中的第一天。

words.example_en: In my eagerness to explore the school, I rushed out of the door early.
words.example_cn: 由于急切想探索学校,我一早就冲出了家门。

words.example_en: I decided to explore the campus before the first class began.
words.example_cn: 第一节课开始前,我决定去探索一下校园。

words.example_en: I tried to turn on my brain, but the engine just would not start.
words.example_cn: 我试图启动大脑,可这台引擎就是发动不起来。

words.example_en: I thought of telling the class about my insect collection.
words.example_cn: 我想过向全班介绍我的昆虫收藏。

words.example_en: He proudly showed us his collection of old coins.
words.example_cn: 他自豪地向我们展示他的旧硬币收藏。

words.example_en: I was still organising my words in my head when my turn came.
words.example_cn: 轮到我时,我还在脑子里组织语言。

words.example_en: I breathed deeply and tried to stay calm before speaking.
words.example_cn: 我深深地呼吸,努力在发言前保持镇定。

words.example_en: When everyone laughed, I looked at them in panic.
words.example_cn: 大家都笑起来时,我惊慌地看着他们。

words.example_en: Challenges like this might sometimes put you under pressure.
words.example_cn: 这样的挑战有时会给你带来压力。

words.example_en: New students often feel under pressure during the first week.
words.example_cn: 新生在第一周常常感到压力很大。

words.example_en: Mr Meng told us to keep calm and be prepared.
words.example_cn: 孟老师叫我们保持镇定、做好准备。

words.example_en: Choose the best description of how he felt on his first day.
words.example_cn: 选出对他第一天感受最恰当的描述。

words.example_en: After the class, he felt more confident about his future.
words.example_cn: 课后,他对自己的未来更有信心了。

words.example_en: Each club put up a colourful poster to attract new members.
words.example_cn: 每个社团都贴出彩色海报来吸引新成员。

words.example_en: I joined the badminton club to stay fit and meet new people.
words.example_cn: 我加入了羽毛球社,既能健身又能结识新朋友。

words.example_en: The drama club helps shy students find their inner star.
words.example_cn: 戏剧社帮助腼腆的学生找到内心的明星。

words.example_en: If you love music, you can play the piano or sing in a band.
words.example_cn: 如果你爱音乐,可以弹钢琴或在乐队里唱歌。

words.example_en: In the debate club we argue about the week's hottest topics.
words.example_cn: 在辩论社,我们就本周最热门的话题展开辩论。

words.example_en: The badminton club practises in the gym every Tuesday.
words.example_cn: 羽毛球社每周二在体育馆训练。

words.example_en: One of my goals is to stand on stage at least once this year.
words.example_cn: 我的目标之一是今年至少登台一次。

words.example_en: Members of the debate club argue about important social issues.
words.example_cn: 辩论社的成员就重要的社会议题进行争辩。

words.example_en: Each week we choose a new topic for our group discussion.
words.example_cn: 每周我们都为小组讨论选一个新话题。

words.example_en: The debate club brings together the school's sharpest minds.
words.example_cn: 辩论社汇集了全校最敏锐的头脑。

words.example_en: She gave a clear and intelligent answer to the difficult question.
words.example_cn: 她对这个难题给出了清晰而聪明的回答。

words.example_en: In the science club we investigate questions about nature.
words.example_cn: 在科学社,我们研究有关大自然的问题。

words.example_en: Students take part in various after-school activities every week.
words.example_cn: 学生们每周参加各种各样的课后活动。

words.example_en: Many senior high students do volunteer work in their free time.
words.example_cn: 许多高中生在空闲时间做志愿工作。

words.example_en: After-school activities help students gain useful skills.
words.example_cn: 课后活动帮助学生获得有用的技能。

words.example_en: Such activities also count when students apply to college.
words.example_cn: 学生申请大学时,这些活动也会被考虑。

words.example_en: Students must learn to organise their busy schedules.
words.example_cn: 学生必须学会安排自己繁忙的日程。

words.example_en: One of her goals was to win an award before leaving school.
words.example_cn: 她的目标之一是在毕业前赢得一个奖项。

words.example_en: Orientation Day is a great opportunity to get to know the school.
words.example_cn: 迎新日是了解学校的好机会。

words.example_en: Lisa is a former student who graduated from our school last June.
words.example_cn: 莉萨是去年六月从我们学校毕业的一名往届学生。

words.example_en: She will graduate from high school and go to college in New York.
words.example_cn: 她将高中毕业,然后去纽约上大学。

words.example_en: Lisa was frightened at the sight of her first test paper.
words.example_cn: 莉萨一看到第一张试卷就害怕了。

words.example_en: She was not selected for the end-of-year competition.
words.example_cn: 她没有入选年终比赛。

words.meaning_cn: 好的;整洁的;令人愉快的
words.example_en: "Neat!" said the interviewer when he heard Lisa's advice.
words.example_cn: 听到莉萨的建议,采访者说:"太棒了!"

words.example_en: When you scan a text, you look for a specific piece of information.
words.example_cn: 略读文章时,你要寻找某条具体信息。

words.example_en: I wrote a journal entry about my first week at senior high.
words.example_cn: 我写了一篇关于高中第一周的日记。

words.example_en: At junior high, I took lots of notes during every class.
words.example_cn: 在初中时,我每节课都记很多笔记。

words.example_en: The teacher saw that I was struggling with note-taking.
words.example_cn: 老师看出我在记笔记上很吃力。

words.example_en: As a class member, I thought about how to improve our school.
words.example_cn: 作为班级一员,我思考着如何改善我们的学校。
